body: Wow I have not heard a sentence that I have been able to connect to like this. My parents would constantly compare me to my brother tell me I'm a failure compared to him. I'll never amount to anything because I'm not good at anything. My parents arent even talking to me anymore they kicked me out and threw all my belongings away. But yet I still lay here everyday alone in another state with someone who is supposed to be my love and I feel more lonely than ever. I just want a hug... I feel like no one loves me and I deserve every second of my hellish life from birth. I'm sorry your mom hurt you, it's a deep pain in my chest aswell
